reason: The hypothesis combines the specific Hf-coated VZrHfNbTa system from P14 with the well-known Al-addition strategy for Al2O3 formation (P4, P32, P41) and proposes that Al doping in the coating will react with the Zr diffusion already observed in P14 to form a graded composite HfO2–Al2O3 scale. This integration of a substrate-diffusion phenomenon with a coating-alloying intervention to engineer a dual-phase oxide is not stated in any single passage, and the proposed mechanism linking Zr interdiffusion to Al2O3 incorporation goes beyond the individual findings.
